segments.line: The pilot reports it as soon as he lands. A
person in a jetpack, next to a passenger jet.
That has actually happened. In twenty twenty, airline pilots flying into Los Angeles
reported a person in a jetpack at about three thousand feet. The
FBI went looking. That
night, the jetpack is on the news.
Mo sends you the clip with forty-two crying-laughing faces.
Across town, an engineer at the power company is staring at a graph.
Three huge power dips this week. All of them from one street.
Yours. And there's one more
phone call. The bank teller makes it. In
America, fake money isn't just a job for the police. It's a job for the
Secret Service. The same people who guard the President. They were
started in eighteen sixty-five for one reason: to catch people making fake money.
Friday evening, three black cars park outside your house, right behind the three sports cars that shouldn't exist. A
man in a gray suit rings the doorbell. He
holds up two bills. Same serial number. "
These are very good," he says. " Too good. Nobody can print these. So how are you doing it?"
Behind him, a van with a satellite dish parks across the road. Your phone
buzzes. It's Mo. " Dude. Why is there a
helicopter over your house?" And the man in the suit
looks right past you, at the controller on the kitchen table.
